payload.title: Present incomplete optimization runs consistently
payload.description:
Keep the Report record, embedded procedure summary, and living report lifecycle aligned when evidence is incomplete.

Feature: Consistent optimization terminal status
  Scenario: A portfolio run finishes with incomplete evidence
    Given an optimization portfolio run cannot complete its required evidence
    When the procedure and living Report reach a terminal state
    Then the Report record is presented as incomplete rather than completed
    And the embedded procedure summary presents the same incomplete outcome
    And neither surface implies the analysis completed successfully

  Scenario: A portfolio run completes all required evidence
    Given an optimization portfolio run completes all required evidence
    When the procedure and living Report reach a terminal state
    Then both surfaces present the run as completed
